verdict.rationale: Tailscale's evidence covers connectivity, ACL policy files, and API/CLI automation, but there is no documented feature for bulk-exporting all account/tailnet data in an open, portable format for users who want to leave the service. missing for 10: explicit data export/portability tooling, documentation of an account data-export feature, and any independent confirmation that a user can fully extract their tailnet configuration and history in an open format.
